sources.title: M-VAVE - Product Ecosystem
sources.excerpt: M-VAVE's official Product Ecosystem provides the manufacturer catalog for its effect-pedal range and explicitly lists the exact model Overdrive DB. This identifies the named M-VAVE/CUVAVE overdrive within the maker's own product lineup instead of relying on similarly named Blues or Tube Screamer variants.

next_action: Use this evidence to write the canonical research record; do not infer unsupported component/version claims.
